comment: She is one of the kindest professors in Richmond. Just take her and you will be fine.

Professor Dolson did genuinely help me improve my writing, she is a very easy grader but still gives good feedback. She is always open if you need help outside of class, and that is when I personally saw the most growth. She appreciates participation during in class discussion, and she pushes you to think deeper.
Professor Dolson is really nice and sweet. Take her FYS if there is a choice. Easy A by treating the graded work seriously and putting your thinking on it. Enjoy the chill class and warm community!

dolson is so nice and just genuinely a good person. she is a little bit disorganized though. she never gives clear instructions and always kinda has a very airy/hippie vibe. i also wouldn't say she grades papers that easily. but, she always emphasizes that she's available to meet after class and will discuss your grade with you.

Professor Dolson's class was a great experience for me, and she honestly made me a more clear and concise writer. If you need help, just ask. She is usually available and will help you greatly with your writing process. Although sometimes her directions weren't the most clear, her class was really fun and she always fostered a warm environment.

Prof Dolson was disorganized and wasnt clear about instructions or what she wanted from us as students, but she was trying. Although this was frustrating, she is a nice lady who cares about her students and is always willing to meet with you outside of class. Put in some effort, meet with her, and listen to her suggestions, and you will do fine.

Prof Dolson is one of the kindest professors at this university and she works really hard to make sure her classes are interesting to those taking it. That being said, she is quite disorganized and is bad at pinning down exactly what she wants for an assignment. But, if you talk with her outside of class she'll help you out and give extensions.

Super nice lady that clearly has passion for everything she teaches. However she can be very disorganized. While explaining assignments she can be very unclear and  you will have to ask several questions to really understand what she wants. Very willing to meet with you and help you though. Kind of a lot of reading, but not too much. TOUGH GRADER!!

Professor Dolson is a little all over the place, but she's a super nice woman. Discussions in her class are really interesting, even if they're not on topic. Even though it's a little frustrating not knowing exactly what she wants, I would still take her class again.

Prof Dolson is a great professor! She's very interested in both the topic at hand and in keeping her students interested.  Loves using technology in and out of the classroom.  Is always willing to talk to you for hours outside of class, even if you're not necessarily talking about class. I'd love to have her again!

Grades fairly - if you wrote a crappy paper the night before, she will grade accordingly.  Her assignments keep you busy though.  Don't procrasinate, schedule plenty of office hours if you need the help, and you will do fine.  She tries to make class as creative and interesting as possible.  The best of expos profs

The most awesome professor. She is gorgeous. Highly recommended to take her class if you really wanna improve your writing. She tries her best to help you out and a very good grader. She is so creative and the class is very interesting. I promise that you will love her as well as her class.

She definatly has a bias towards women and athletes.  If you fit into one of these two catagories you should get an A.  Normal guys, this class will be hard to say the least.  Work hard and get a B+, don't work at all and get a B-.  Meaningless comments.

She is a very helpful person. Very willing to work with you on individual basis, encourages your creativity but also wants you to master writing like it should be mastered. A great, understanding teacher for someone whose first language is not English.
